snippet.title: Moduwar - Early Access Release trailer
snippet.description:
Buy Moduwar on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/923100/Moduwar/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=eatrailer

Moduwar was just released in Early Access on Steam. We're looking for your support and feedback while continuing to work on the game. Don't hesitate to share your ideas with us!

Moduwar is an adaptive organic RTS where you control an alien creature, Modu - and your body is your army. Grow new organs, split, merge and mutate them into unique units that adapt to your needs as you fight against human and alien threats in single and multiplayer modes.
